parameters.P1 value of what they make (30): How far their product is from commodity, read from their own product description.
parameters.P2 range (10): How many small, varied lots they buy (suits Anantha's 500 kg minimum).
parameters.P3 structure (20): Corporate with product development 20, private or public limited 15, LLP 10, proprietorship or partnership 5.
parameters.P4 quantity (20): How much relevant yarn they could consume. Turnover under Rs 1.5 Cr 5, Rs 1.5-25 Cr 10, above Rs 25 Cr 20.
parameters.P5 margin (20): Own brand and develops products 20, one of the two 15, maker or trader 10, price-led trader 5.

how_good_it_is: Tested blind on 30 existing customers whose real purchase quantity is known: the score put 27% of them in the right quantity band. Putting every company in the middle band does about as well.
proposal_pending: Ritika proposes reweighting to 10/10/0/40/40. On the same blind test, precision in the top quarter rises from 60% to 73%. Not approved.
